func decodeOSPF(data []byte, p gopacket.PacketBuilder) error {
	if len(data) < 14 {
		return fmt.Errorf("Packet too smal for OSPF")
	}

	switch uint8(data[0]) {
	case 2:
		ospf := &OSPFv2{}
		return decodingLayerDecoder(ospf, data, p)
	case 3:
		ospf := &OSPFv3{}
		return decodingLayerDecoder(ospf, data, p)
	default:
	}

	return fmt.Errorf("Unable to determine OSPF type.")
}
